[[Shakahm's Striker]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Shakahm the Summoner]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Domain of Secrets]].

==Stats==
:[[Lightning damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Channeling Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Channeling Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Energy#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy regeneration]] -1
